name: Click Before Frames
description: iOS input-buffer control prototype with one universal max-delay value shared by all gameplay modes, plus a separate optional debugger. No per-mode delay limits. Input interception remains disabled.

max-delay-ticks.name: Max input delay (ticks)
max-delay-ticks.description: One universal maximum input-delay value used across the entire input-buffer system; the same value applies to every gameplay mode with no per-mode overrides. 0 = OFF/raw input; 1–64 selects the tick limit. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS. This is not the game's physics tick rate.

debugger-enabled.name: Input buffer debugger
debugger-enabled.description: Separately enable/disable diagnostic logs for the one universal input-delay value. Does not change the selected delay or any gameplay setting.
